description: For each Options value [omitted, dbInconsistent 16, dbConsistent 32] and a fresh dynaset over "SELECT P2.ID AS PID, P2.N AS PN, C2.ID AS CID, C2.V AS CV FROM P2 INNER JOIN C2 ON P2.ID = C2.PID ORDER BY C2.ID" with held Fields PID, PN, CID and CV: (a) AddNew, assign PID 3 and PN 30, Update, Errors; (b) AddNew, assign CID 10 and CV 'n' only, Update, Errors; (c) AddNew, assign PID 1, CID 11 and CV 'm', Update, Errors; (d) MoveFirst, Delete, Errors, EditMode, BOF, EOF; then close and read the base tables P2 (ID, N) and C2 (ID, PID, V) through snapshots. Asks which base row an AddNew or Delete on a join touches, the effect of the options and of the declared relationship, and the rows left in each base table. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
